label: Preferences
description: Browser-local persistent named values stored directly through IndexedDB structured cloning.

preferenceValue.description: Any value supported by the browser's IndexedDB structured-clone implementation.

preferenceMetadata.description: Optional display metadata. Omitted fields preserve their current values during an update.

label.description: Human-readable label. Defaults to the preference name when the record is created.

description.description: Human-readable description. Defaults to an empty string when the record is created.

preferenceRecords.description: Preference records ordered by their unique names.

id.description: Immutable UUID generated when the preference is created.

modifiedAt.description: Timestamp of the last successful write in UTC.

revision.description: Current revision, starting at one and incrementing on every successful update.

value.description: Native structured-clone value. No JSON-only schema is applied.

set.description: Creates or atomically updates a preference. Updates preserve id, name, createdAt, and omitted metadata while replacing value and incrementing revision.

get.description: Returns the stored value, or defaultValue only when no record exists. A stored undefined value remains distinguishable from absence.

delete.description: Deletes the preference with the supplied name when present.

list.description: Lists full preference records in deterministic name order. A non-empty prefix is applied through the unique name index.
